name: Thumbnail composite
summary: A still image built from a face cut-out, one object, a pointer and 1 to 3 words, made to read at a very small size.
how: Make the image 1280x720 and test it at 168px wide.
Cut out one face and give it a 6px white edge.
Add one arrow or circle in a strong colour.
Set 1 to 3 words in a heavy face with an 8px outline.

origin.note: A change in the ranking of the site to reward watch time makes the image that wins a click a main part of a video.

adoptions.via: Creators on YouTube compete for clicks with loud, face-led stills.
Short video makers copy the bold words and strong colour into caption frames.
